author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
How to distill a textbook from Claude/GPT's weights?
1. Get the table of content of the textbook
2. Turn the table of content into questions one section at a time.
3. Start a new chat session, ask the LLM explain a chapter to you as a college student taking the course
4. Repeat and loop, until you get all the chapters
5. Commit your "clean room" distilled textbook to a github repo
The wordings may not be exactly the same, but you can still reusable concepts and knowledge for your AI agents.
